title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1268: End of battle (1)

section.p: A rain of blood was falling.
Of the three bodies the Devil Pseudo Emperor had, two had been eaten. Or to be precise, he had detonated two of them.
Silence engulfed the world.
The Nether, Immortal, Divine, Dragon, Primordial Giant, Fate, Spirit, and other Pseudo Emperors appeared.
The Immortal Pseudo Emperor’s cold voice rang out, “Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor, how dare you attack the Devil Pseudo Emperor? You must be punished for this audacity.”
“You must be punished!”

The other Pseudo Emperors agreed. Two Pseudo Emperors had ambushed a Pseudo Emperor, resulting in the loss of two tri-life bodies. This was not a small matter. They had to do something lest they became the next to suffer a similar fate.

Meanwhile, the big furball was still flying all over the place due to the explosion in his body. Like a leaking balloon, he was slowly reducing in size. After some time, he returned to the female furball’s side.

He looked around at all the Pseudo Emperors before looking at the little furball who was trying to leave the ancient city. He blinked at the little furball before turning to face the female furball. They looked at each other for a moment before vanishing together.
Right before leaving, the big furball shot Su Yu a doubtful look. But his gaze did not linger.
A River of Time appeared as the two departed. Through the river, everyone saw a massive heavenly source fruit tree. The two furballs were sprawled atop the tree.
The big furball said nothing.

As for the female furball, she put her hands on her hips and shouted, “We’re done eating! We’re back home now! That Pseudo Emperor was the one trying to eat our young lad first! If he stops trying to eat our young lad, we won’t eat him!”
She paused to burp with satisfaction. She had eaten enough to satisfy her hunger. She continued, “I’m not lying! We’re going to sleep now! Bye bye!”
As the female furball waved to everyone, a creak rang out, as though a door had been shut.
Goodbye!
It was time to stop. As far as she was concerned, they had a valid reason to eat the Devil Pseudo Emperor.

The two furballs were not stupid. They knew that they had attracted too much attention. Thus, they had decided it was time for them to go back home. As long as they were back home, they would not need to fear the other Pseudo Emperors anymore.
With no other dependents apart from that little fellow, they had nothing to fear, especially when they were back home and both of them were together.
It wasn’t like the other Pseudo Emperors would do anything apart from sending some threats their way. What even was the point of fighting two Pseudo Emperors to the death unless absolutely necessary?
Suddenly, the same creak rang out again as the portal of the Soul Devourer Realm reopened.
“Burp…”
It was the big furball.

After burping, he shouted despite his weakened state, “Hey! Uhm…we’re not eating anymore! Our young lad is still very young! Don’t bully him! You are so old already. Why are you bullying him? If you keep bullying him, we will eat your young as well!”

With that, the same creak rang out as he shut the portal like he was shutting a door. As far as they were concerned, this was the end of the matter. If those people were unhappy, they were free to invade.

Or they could form a blockade outside. It didn’t matter. The two furballs wouldn’t mind even if the blockade lasted centuries. As for the risk of having their entire realm destroyed, well, that was doable if the many Pseudo Emperors joined hands. But…would they?
Were they not afraid of driving the two furballs crazy? That would be too extreme. With the two furballs gone, the other Pseudo Emperors arrived outside the Devil Realm in mere moments.
All the Pseudo Emperors overlooked the Devil Realm thoughtfully.

Tiangu asked, “Devil Emperor, are you fine? Without your tri-life bodies, the Devil Realm will be in danger. The humans are treacherous. Be careful lest they launch a sneak attack on you. If you trust us, we are willing to protect the southern sector on behalf of the devils.”
The Devil Pseudo Emperor’s voice rang out throughout the Allheaven Battlefield, “All devil Eternals are to return immediately.”
With that command, the devils, who were already feeling greatly anxious, started withdrawing.

Even the blood fire devil fighting Great Xia King took the risk of receiving a saber strike just so he could break free from the fight and flee. Great Xia King did not give chase. That devil was too strong. If the devil decided to fight with everything on the line, there was no guarantee that Great Xia King would be the one to emerge victorious in the end.

Among the withdrawing devil kings, some were carrying heavy injuries. One of them looked miserable after losing a tri-life body. Not far behind, a joyful Niu Baidao could be seen flying away with a carrier treasure in hand.

As he flew, he kept praising his wisdom inwardly. He had guessed that something would happen to the devils. Thus, he had been waiting patiently. When all the other Invincibles were distracted by the Devil Pseudo Emperor, he pounced on a devil Invincible and risked seriously injuring himself to kill a tri-life body. And he had profited from his foresight.
As the devil Invincibles started their return trip, the projections of numerous devil Invincibles appeared above the Devil Realm.

With a calm voice, the Devil Pseudo Emperor said, “There is no need to trouble yourself for us, friends. With nearly a hundred Eternals in our ranks, we are more than capable of maintaining peace in the southern sector. What’s the big deal about losing some tri-life bodies? This is but a minor injury.”

Right after saying that, an incomparably powerful aura rose from the Devil Realm. At the same time, the expression of a devil Invincible changed rapidly. He started wailing, but it was cut short moments later, followed by a loud rumble.

His past and future bodies exploded while the aura of his present body changed into the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s aura. In the blink of an eye, his appearance transformed into that of the Devil Pseudo Emperor. With the transformation complete, he vanished with a flicker.
The Devil Realm shook as crimson clouds appeared in the sky.
As for the other devil Invincibles, some frowned while some exhaled in relief.
How fortunate that it wasn’t them.

A devil Invincible was dead, but the Devil Pseudo Emperor had regained some of his strength. Ordinarily, the other devils would feel a sort of sympathy toward the dead Invincible. But everyone was quite understanding this time.

The Devil Pseudo Emperor needed to regain some strength and deter the myriad races from doing anything stupid. When the fate of the entire race was at risk, the death of one Invincible to alleviate the risk was acceptable. In any case, that dead Invincible was only a relatively new Invincible.

The Devil Pseudo Emperor had demonstrated his ability to regain a tri-life body instantly. His new tri-life body seemed slightly weaker than his previous tri-life bodies, but the difference was negligible.
The devils were different from the humans.

There was no Emperor among humanity, but humanity was still doing considerably well. That was mainly due to humanity’s immunity toward the suppressive force of the various realms. That was enough to deter the myriad races from being too excessive. But this wasn’t the case for the devils. Without their Pseudo Emperor, they might even splinter into various smaller factions and sink into chaos.

There might be a suppressive force in the Devil Realm, but it wouldn’t help if the myriad races were to attack and destroy the realm from the outside. In comparison, the Human Realm was much harder to destroy from the outside. After all, that was a realm with an Emperor during the ancient past.
After regaining one tri-life body, the Devil Pseudo Emperor stopped even if he had more bodies prepared as spares. Suddenly, the Divine Pseudo Emperor laughed.

He exchanged gazes with the Immortal Pseudo Emperor. Then, they each threw a palm attack toward Mo Duona. They knew what the Devil Pseudo Emperor was doing. He was trying to nurture Mo Duona into a powerful tri-life body of his.
In that case, Mo Duona should die. Without Mo Duona, who would the Devil Pseudo Emperor use to regain his future body?

The Devil Pseudo Emperor’s new past body had been formed hastily with only a fresh Invincible. If he did not find a better option for his future body, he would be much weaker than before even after restoring all his tri-life bodies.

The projection of the Devil Pseudo Emperor appeared above the Devil Realm. He looked at the two, but he said nothing. Instead, he looked at the Divine and Immortal Realms before looking at the young divines and immortals in the Allheaven Battlefield. He did not even bother to verbalize his threat.

After killing Mo Duona, they had to make sure they could suppress the Devil Realm for eternity. Otherwise, he would make a move the moment he found an opportunity to kill every single divine and immortal from the younger generation. He would do it recklessly.

Instantly, the two Pseudo Emperors stopped. Tiangu smiled and grabbed Mo Duona like he was grabbing a chick instead. After pulling Mo Duona away, he said, “I was worried that something bad would happen to Mo Dona. It’s not safe to stay near so many ancient cities.”
The Devil Pseudo Emperor said nothing.

The Immortal Pseudo Emperor studied Mo Duona and said thoughtfully, “Cultivate hard. The future of the Devil Realm lies on your shoulders. The Devil Emperor has sustained heavy injuries. Without enough strength, how can you protect the Devil Realm?”
He was basically telling Mo Duona to cultivate hard since he was a spare body without saying it. Only if he was strong enough would the Devil Pseudo Emperor be able to recover quickly.

Mo Duona lowered his head and said nothing. His ancestor and teacher were both devil kings, but both merely frowned with inscrutable expressions. None of them wanted to see anything happen to the Devil Pseudo Emperor.

As one of the overlords of the Myriad Realms, the devils were very powerful. But without the Devil Pseudo Emperor, the devils would lose their advantage over the humans. Furthermore, the devils could very well splinter into various factions and lose their unity.

The Blood Fire Devil King had rushed back, risking injury just to stop his battle against Great Xia King. Was he back to protect the Devil Pseudo Emperor, or was he back for some other motives? Nobody knew.

The original devils might be the rulers of the greater devil race, but the blood fire devils weren’t weak either. For some reason, one ruled while the other had to serve as the vanguard in any war involving the devils. Was the Blood Fire Devil King really happy about that? He was strong enough to suppress even Great Xia King. He was definitely comparable in strength to regular Pseudo Emperors.

The Devil Pseudo Emperor said nothing about what the two Pseudo Emperors did. After restoring his past body, he had calmed down significantly. He said, “With the existence of those two among the soul devourers, the Soul Devourer Pseudo Emperor is most certainly an extremely ancient existence. Immortal Emperor Tiangu, do you know him?”
After a short silence, Tiangu said, “I might have seen him before.”

He finally understood why he had been feeling that sense of crisis. The two furballs had most likely been waiting for him outside the Immortal Realm not long ago. He was stronger than the Devil Pseudo Emperor.

The two soul devourers might not be able to do too much to him. But someone else could take advantage of that and act against him while he was occupied by the two furballs. And that could be disastrous. The myriad races would not cooperate in all matters.

They were fairly united in their policies against humanity. As for the soul devourers…what was the point? Just like them, the two furballs would be subjected to the suppressive force when invading a foreign realm.

Why would anyone want to risk provoking them when the threat they posed was controllable? They would be safe from the furballs by retreating to their respective realms. That was not the case for the humans. They could keep the pursuit anywhere with their immunity to the suppressive force of realms. That was why the myriad realms had been so united against humanity.

With the return of the devil Invincibles, the various battles stopped one after another. With so many Invincibles removed from the battlefield at once, the Invincibles of the other races turned wary as well. Some had also stopped fighting because of their fear of the two soul devourers.

Xia Longwu had completed his dao affirmation. Su Yu and the others were hiding under the protection of so many stone statues. Most of the humans capable of affirming their dao had completed their advancements by now. There was no point in continuing the fight.

Sure, they could still find a way to kill Su Yu, such as what the Devil Pseudo Emperor had attempted to do. But would the Devil Pseudo Emperor still dare to leave his realm after this? He would most definitely be wary of the other Pseudo Emperors now that he was weakened. It wasn’t like the Devil Realm would collapse if Su Yu was left alive.

Meanwhile, the Devil Realm could very well collapse if he were to leave and get himself killed. The threats presented by Su Yu, Wan Tiansheng, and the others would manifest in the future, not the present. There was no need to be in such a rush to deal with them.
